name: stremio-linux-shell
note: Reference only; the source inputs are upstream project URLs, not AUR. The recipe borrows the -git recipe's schema, man page, translation and dependency fixes; the wrapper and D-Bus service are local.
local_adaptations: Use the v1.3.0 release tarball instead of the AUR's epoch-1 packaging; no epoch is needed for a new Devario package.
Install the GSettings schema, translations and man page system-wide, and keep DBusActivatable by installing a D-Bus service file pointing at /usr/bin/stremio.

Drop the AUR's wrapper-side glxinfo/GSK workaround, LC_NUMERIC export and mesa-utils/openssl/libayatana-appindicator dependencies; the 1.3.0 binary handles the renderer and locale itself, and no AppIndicator library is linked.
Run the build with isolated Cargo state, explicit GETTEXT_DIR/GSETTINGS_SCHEMA_DIR and STREMIO_LOCALEDIR; keep the private binary and server.js under /usr/lib/stremio.
Declare data/server.js's proprietary license as LicenseRef-Stremio and ship a notice; only the Rust shell is GPL-3.0-only.
